slots.sentence: Yes, we just got news today that the Democratic Governors Association and also the Democratic governor of Illinois, the billionaire, J.B. Pritzker, are giving a million dollars each to Gina Hinojosa, who is the Democratic candidate there running against Governor Greg Abbott.
